description: Curated assembly responsibilities; equations and code bytes are extracted from their authoritative sources.

equations.eq:reference_fluid_mass: Forms the complete fluid component storage M; flux and source are assembled separately.

aliases._phi: Current phase volume fraction phi; dimensionless.
aliases._eta: Component mass fraction eta; dimensionless; omitted for pure solids.
aliases._storage: Mass per solid reference volume M; kg/m³.

equations.eq:discrete_euler: Backward Euler, including the first BDF2 step.
equations.eq:discrete_bdf: Variable-step BDF2 on the entire stored mass.

aliases._mass: Complete AD reference mass at the current step.
aliases._dt, _dt_old: Current and previous step sizes; s.

equations.eq:discrete_euler: Same complete-mass backward Euler formula for both EG rows.
equations.eq:discrete_bdf: Same variable-step BDF2 formula; histories are not differentiated.
equations.eq:eg_residual: Supplies D_t M as an AD property to the volume rows.

aliases._rate: Reference mass rate D_t M; kg/(m³ s).

equations.eq:weak_fluid: Assembles the negative source and negative test-gradient/flux volume terms; storage and boundary terms are separate.
equations.eq:weak_solid: Assembles the negative source term with flux omitted.

aliases._source: Reference production S = J sum nu r; kg/(m³ s).
aliases._flux: Complete reference component flux H; kg/(m² s).

equations.eq:weak_momentum: Volume terms only: nominal stress, gravity and material-insertion force. Traction is a separate boundary object.

aliases._rho_f: Partial fluid density rho_f = phi_f rhobar_f; kg/m³.
aliases._conversion: Net current aqueous mass production sum dot c_f; kg/(m³ s).
aliases._F, _W: Skeleton deformation F and bulk reference mass flux W_f.
aliases._J * _rho: J times total current mixture density; kg/m³.

equations.eq:weak_tau: Local tested evolution of tau at fixed solid reference coordinate.

aliases._u_dot: Time derivative of tau at fixed X.
aliases._test: Scalar test; tau has units m²/s.

equations.eq:weak_gauss: Dielectric-gradient and negative charge volume terms; outward electric displacement is separate.

equations.eq:weak_fluid: Positive tested prescribed outward component mass flux on Gamma_h.
equations.eq:weak_gauss: Positive tested outward electric displacement on Gamma_q.

aliases._flux: Prescribed outward reference flux; physical units depend on the mass/electric row.

equations.eq:weak_momentum: Negative tested prescribed nominal traction on Gamma_T.

aliases._traction: Reference outward traction P N; Pa.

equations.eq:piola_flux: Forms eta W_f + J F^-1 j from supplied current relative flux; it does not solve the mobility closure for W_f.
equations.eq:reference_fluid_mass: Reference source S = J times supplied current source.
equations.eq:weak_gauss: Forms the pulled-back dielectric and reference charge used by Gauss assembly.

aliases._j: Supplied current relative component flux; kg/(m² s).

equations.eq:mineral_solve: Positive-tangent branch root bar J_s; the called helper performs branch selection and AD Newton.
equations.eq:phase_biot: Per-phase compression contribution accumulated into the aggregate coefficient.
equations.eq:total_stress: Effective mineral, pore-pressure and optional Maxwell stresses, pulled back as P = J sigma F^-T.

aliases._K[s], _Ks[s]: Allocated skeleton modulus K and intrinsic mineral modulus K_s; Pa.
aliases.b_ad: True mineral volume ratio bar J_s, solved in AD.
aliases._densities: Intrinsic mineral densities rho_s0/bar J_s; kg/m³.

equations.eq:motion: F = I + Grad_X u and J = det F; rejects J <= 0.
equations.eq:rates: Supplies the time rate of J for diagnostics.
equations.eq:piola_flux: Supplies F^-1 and J F^-1 to pullback materials.

aliases._F, _J: Skeleton deformation gradient and its positive determinant.

equations.eq:motion: Velocity from displacement time derivatives at fixed X.

equations.eq:eg_space: Adds the backbone and optional constant enrichment; computes corresponding reference gradients.

aliases._value: Reconstructed scalar; units depend on the field.

equations.eq:eg_residual: Element storage/source and broken reference-gradient flux terms only; interior facets and boundary flux are separate.

aliases._reference_flux: Full supplied H, evaluated on the reconstructed field.
aliases._reference_component_storage_rate: Complete-mass AD rate for nonlinear tests; a constant-coefficient mode is available for MMS.

equations.eq:eg_residual: P0 storage/source terms. The gradient volume term vanishes. Optional enrichment anchor is zero in the silica tests.

aliases._test: Constant MONOMIAL test; nonconstant enrichment is rejected.
aliases._reference_component_storage_rate: Same complete-mass rate as the continuous row.

equations.eq:eg_flux: Arithmetic normal flux average plus diagonal mobility penalty, with opposite element/neighbor signs. sigma=12 is specified in the numerical decks; the object default is 4.
equations.eq:eg_residual: Facet flux term and adjoint term for the P0 enrichment row (zero gradient in that row). epsilon=-1 gives SIP.

aliases._reference_flux, _reference_flux_neighbo: Supplied H on the two cells.
aliases._u - _u_neighbor: Jump of the P0 enrichment; the continuous field has no jump.
aliases.normal_mobility: Arithmetic average n·D·n; optional frozen absolute penalty only.

equations.eq:eg_residual: Adjoint-consistency contribution for continuous tests; the field jump comes from the coupled enrichment.

aliases._grad_test: Continuous test gradient on each side.

equations.eq:eg_flux: Off-diagonal mobility contribution to the facet penalty for a coupled diffusion block; the supplied full row flux is assembled by the diagonal flux object.
equations.eq:eg_residual: Signed cross penalty and P0 adjoint contributions; coupled MMS extension of the displayed scalar form.

aliases._mobility: Signed off-diagonal mobility block; no absolute-value substitution.
aliases._column_enrichment: Jump source in the other transported field.

equations.eq:eg_residual: Signed off-diagonal adjoint-consistency term for continuous tests; coupled diffusion extension of the scalar form.

aliases._column_enrichment: Other field whose jump enters the adjoint term.

equations.eq:eg_residual: Weak-Dirichlet extension: physical outward flux, diagonal adjoint term and penalty. The displayed equation uses prescribed natural flux instead; this object is used by MMS, not by the closed silica column.

aliases.mismatch: Reconstructed field minus prescribed boundary value.

equations.eq:eg_residual: Signed off-diagonal adjoint/penalty extension for weak Dirichlet data; physical row flux is already supplied by the diagonal boundary object.

aliases.mismatch: Other reconstructed field minus its boundary value.

equations.eq:eg_flux: Boundary counterpart used with weak Dirichlet data: physical flux plus penalty. It is a diagnostic postprocessor, not an additional residual.
equations.eq:eg_residual: Integrates the outward numerical boundary flux for the MMS conservation audit.

aliases._reference_flux: Physical reference flux on the boundary.
aliases._sigma / h: Same penalty scale as the corresponding boundary object.
aliases.MetaPhysicL::raw_value: Diagnostic extraction only; this does not enter Newton residual assembly.

equations.eq:eg_flux: Supplies H=-D Grad_X q and isotropic D for manufactured tests of the displayed numerical flux.
Supplies full row fluxes for a synthetic SPD two-field diffusion block: diagonal 1 and 2, cross 0.25. It tests cross assembly and does not implement the full reacting aqueous closure.

aliases._flux_p, _flux_q: Full synthetic row fluxes including cross coupling.

equations.eq:silica_coordinate: Inverts the monotone chemical-potential coordinate using logit Newton in AD.
equations.eq:silica_diffusion: Recovers mass fractions and supplies silicic-acid flux; water flux follows by zero sum and is not stored independently.
equations.eq:silica_rate: Implements mechanism (3) of the binary silica/water test subsystem, its mass sources and nonnegative reaction power.
equations.eq:aqueous_mole_fractions: Uses the two-component restriction to convert mole fraction to mass fraction.

aliases.q: Total dimensionless potential coordinate, including P0 enrichment.
aliases._rate: k = K_(3) R; mol/(m³ s), supplied by the input deck.
aliases._source_f, _source_s: -M_7 r_(3) and M_C r_(3); kg/(m³ s).
aliases._mobility: ell; kg s/m³; zero in the batch.
aliases._D: ell R theta/M_7 times identity, evaluated in the fixed J=1 test.
